what: The section is pinned and tilted cards rise one by one from below over the large center title and stack in place — .6 of a screen of scroll per card

options.[data-fx-part=card]: Cards that stack (children) — position and tilt are set by the consumer’s CSS
options.min: Only at this width and above, default 810 · 0 means all widths (fixed on phones too in one reference site)
options.first: If stay, the first card stays in place and the second onward rise up and cover it (three Brand photos)
options.length: Pinned scroll length (px) — if given, used instead of per (Brand 3000)
options.scrub: Lag (seconds) when following scroll — default tied directly (true) · Brand 1
options.ease: Curve per card — default none · Brand’s original gives no curve, so GSAP’s default power1.out applies

from.where: index.html .kt-photos__list — pins three screen-height photos stacked (start top top · end +=3000 · scrub 1) The second and third rise one after another from translate 100vh to 0 with duration 4 each, covering the one below. The big Cinzel name spanning the photo stays as is inside the fixed panel
from.options: first: stay; length: 3000; scrub: 1; ease: power1.out; min: 0
